name: Securities Settlement Transaction Audit Trail Report 002 V 05
definition: Scope|This message is sent by the Market Infrastructure to the CSD to advise of the history of all the statuses, modifications, replacement and cancellation of a specific transaction during its whole life cycle when the instructing party is a direct participant to the Settlement Infrastructure.||Usage|The message may also be used to: |- re-send a message sent by the market infrastructure to the direct participant,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the market infrastructure for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the market infrastructure for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message (within a statement) and continuation indicator to indicate that the statement is to continue or that the message is the last page of the statement.

QueryReference.name: Query Reference
QueryReference.definition: Identification of the SecuritiesStatusQuery message sent to request this report.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

StatusTrail.name: Status Trail
StatusTrail.definition: Provides the history of status and reasons for a pending, posted or cancelled transaction.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
